_comment: The compliance video's script. Same shape as one entry of videos.json and checked against the same videos.schema.json ($defs/video), but kept in its own file because every claim here names a NIST SP 800-53 control (AC-6, SC-7, AU-12), and videos.json may type no digits (tests/test_video_facts.py). Every claim is traceable: FedRAMP wording and the control ids to docs/compliance.md, the read-only and never-reads-Secrets invariants to docs/safety-contract.md, the DNS-only chart NetworkPolicy and no-outbound-connections posture to SECURITY.md, and the no-accounts/no-telemetry/on-your-machine-only wording to PRIVACY.md. The last scene before the end card carries the disclaimer; do not remove it.
title: kube-noob and three compliance regimes

scenes.caption: Built for platforms that get audited
scenes.vo: kube-noob runs on platforms that get audited. Here is how its design reads against three regimes.
scenes.say: kube noob runs on platforms that get audited. Here is how its design reads against three regimes.

scenes.caption: FedRAMP authorises services. This is not one.
scenes.vo: kube-noob holds no FedRAMP authorisation. FedRAMP authorises cloud service offerings, assessed by a third party.
scenes.say: kube noob holds no FedRAMP authorisation. FedRAMP authorises cloud service offerings, assessed by a third party.

scenes.caption: Deployable inside a boundary you already had
scenes.vo: It widens nothing: no outbound calls of its own, no third-party processor, no new trust boundary.
scenes.say: It widens nothing: no outbound calls of its own, no third party processor, no new trust boundary.
answer: No outbound network calls of its own
No third-party processor, no new trust boundary
Read-only, never reads Secrets — AC-6 Least Privilege
Chart NetworkPolicy allows DNS only — SC-7 Boundary Protection
Tool calls logged, never their content — AU-12

scenes.caption: No model. No inference.
scenes.vo: The EU AI Act follows the system that infers. kube-noob contains no model and makes no inferences of its own.
scenes.say: The E U A I Act follows the system that infers. kube noob contains no model, and makes no inferences of its own.

scenes.caption: The thinking happens in your assistant
scenes.bubble: Your assistant reasons and writes. kube-noob answers with deterministic rules, under your own AI governance.
scenes.vo: Your assistant does the reasoning, under your own governance. kube-noob returns the same rules every time.
scenes.say: Your assistant does the reasoning, under your own governance. kube noob returns the same rules every time.

scenes.caption: GDPR: your processing, not our badge
scenes.vo: GDPR compliance describes your processing, not a badge a tool holds. kube-noob has no accounts and no telemetry, and your data stays on your own infrastructure.
scenes.say: G D P R compliance describes your processing, not a badge a tool holds. kube noob has no accounts and no telemetry, and your data stays on your own infrastructure.

scenes.caption: docs/compliance.md
scenes.vo: The control mapping is in the repository. Read it at kube-noob dot com.

scenes.caption: Design properties, not a certification and not legal advice. kube-noob holds no FedRAMP, EU AI Act or GDPR certification.
